site.title: Spatial Omics Radar
site.subtitle: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP-Ready Single-Cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics End-to-End Pipeline for Clinical Research
entries.one_liner: Modular Nextflow pipeline processing scRNA-seq and Xenium spatial data into annotated, reproducible outputs for clinical use.

entries.name: SpatialGEO
entries.title: Geometric-aware deep learning for deciphering tissue structure from spatially resolved transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Geometric-aware deep learning framework producing embeddings from expression and spatial coordinates for tissue structure analysis.

entries.name: AESTETIK
entries.title: Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data
entries.one_liner: Convolutional model jointly learns spot representations from spatial, transcriptomic and morphology data for clustering.

entries.name: CONCISE
entries.title: Spatial co-expression and cell-cell communication inference from spatially resolved transcriptomics with CONCISE
entries.one_liner: Statistical framework modeling spatial autocorrelation and count variation to infer ligand-receptor co-expression.

entries.name: in situ graphene-seq
entries.title: In situ graphene-seq: spatial transcriptomics and chronic electrophysiological characterization of tissue microenvironments
entries.one_liner: Platform integrating stretchable graphene electrodes with imaging-based in situ sequencing for chronic electrophysiology and transcriptomics.

entries.name: spammR
entries.title: spammR: an R package designed for analysis and integration of spatial multi-omic measurements
entries.one_liner: R package for end-to-end analysis and integration of spatial multi-omics data, focused on mass-spectrometry measurements.

entries.name: SpaVGMC
entries.title: SpaVGMC: A Unified Representation Learning Framework via Structural and Semantic Alignment in Spatial Transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Graph-based variational representation learning framework for spatial domain identification in transcriptomics data.
entries.venue: Journal of chemical information and modeling

entries.name: AdPrST
entries.title: AdPrST:An Adversarial Graph Deep Learning Pre-clustering Framework for Deciphering Spatiotemporal Structures in Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Adversarial graph GAN framework infers spatial domains and developmental trajectories from spatial transcriptomics.
entries.venue: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics

entries.name: HESTIA
entries.title: HESTIA: Scalable Multimodal Integration of Histology and High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics for Robust Spatial Domain Identification
entries.one_liner: Memory-efficient multimodal algorithm integrating histology and high-resolution spatial transcriptomics to identify spatial domains.

entries.name: DEGAS (spatial smoothing)
entries.title: Identification of high-risk cells in single-cell spatially resolved transcriptomics data using Diagnostic Evidence GAuge of Single-cells with spatial smoothing
entries.one_liner: Extends DEGAS domain-adaptation model with spatial smoothing to flag high-risk cells in spatial transcriptomics data.

entries.name: GCAST
entries.title: Identifying batch-integrated domains from spatial transcriptomics via graph autoencoder with contrastive learning based on cross-modality and data augmentation
entries.one_liner: Graph contrastive autoencoder integrates histology and expression to identify batch-corrected tissue domains.

entries.name: TENGU
entries.title: A transcriptomic-driven segmentation and cell simulation framework for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics and cell-cell communication
entries.one_liner: End-to-end pipeline using transcript density instead of images to segment cells and infer cell-cell communication.

entries.name: Mievformer
entries.title: Probabilistic coupling of cellular and microenvironmental heterogeneity by masked self-supervised learning
entries.one_liner: Transformer trained with masked self-supervision to learn cellular microenvironment representations in spatial data.

entries.name: SpatialQuery
entries.title: SpatialQuery: scalable discovery and molecular characterization of multicellular motifs from spatial omics data
entries.one_liner: Framework identifying recurrent multicellular spatial motifs and characterizing their differential/covariation gene programs.

entries.name: Benchmarking tools for deciphering cellular crosstalk in spatially-resolved transcriptomics
entries.title: Benchmarking tools for deciphering cellular crosstalk in spatially-resolved transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Benchmarks nine cell-cell communication inference methods across simulated and real spatial transcriptomics datasets.

entries.name: Img2Gene
entries.title: Img2Gene: Debiased Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics with Biological Context from Pathology Images
entries.one_liner: Debiased framework predicting spatial gene expression from pathology whole-slide images using causal analysis.
entries.venue: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics

entries.name: STDrug
entries.title: STDrug enables spatially informed personalized drug repurposing from spatial transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Framework using graph convolutional networks and scoring to prioritize patient-specific drug repurposing from spatial data.

entries.name: TOAST
entries.title: Topography-aware optimal transport for alignment of spatial omics data
entries.one_liner: Optimal-transport framework extending fused Gromov-Wasserstein to align spatial tissue slices and map single-cell to spatial data.

entries.name: TUSCAN
entries.title: TUSCAN: Tumor segmentation and classification analysis in spatial transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Constructs spatial copy-number-variation profiles from SRT and H&E images to delineate tumor regions.

entries.name: EnsAgent
entries.title: EnsAgent: a tool-ensemble multiple Agent system for robust annotation in spatial transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Multi-agent LLM system combining ensemble clustering with evidence-based reasoning to annotate spatial transcriptomics domains.

entries.name: MORPHE
entries.title: MORPHE: Bridging Image Generation and Spatial Omics for Tissue Synthesis
entries.one_liner: Diffusion-based generative framework synthesizing and imputing single-cell resolution tissue architecture from spatial omics.

entries.name: Castl
entries.title: Castl: robust identification of spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics via an ensemble-based framework
entries.one_liner: Ensemble framework combines multiple spatially-variable-gene detectors to reduce false discoveries and method bias.

entries.name: AICellType
entries.title: AICellType: a large language model-based platform for accurate cell type annotation
entries.one_liner: Uses LLMs to annotate cell types from marker genes in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

entries.name: mosna
entries.title: mosna Reveals Different Types of Cellular Interactions Predictive of Response to Immunotherapies and Survival in Cancer
entries.one_liner: Python pipeline linking spatial omics data to clinical/survival outcomes via cell interaction and niche features.

entries.name: ovrlpy
entries.title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy
entries.one_liner: Tool identifying overlapping cells and segmentation errors in imaging-based spatial transcriptomics via 3D transcript localization analysis.

entries.name: stDyer-image
entries.title: stDyer-image improves clustering analysis of spatially resolved transcriptomics and proteomics with morphological images
entries.one_liner: End-to-end deep learning framework linking morphology image features directly to cluster labels for spatial transcriptomics/proteomics.

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP Single-cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics end-to-end pipeline for clinical research
entries.one_liner: Modular, regulatory-compliant end-to-end pipeline processing single-cell RNA-seq and Xenium spatial transcriptomics for clinical research.

entries.name: SpotSweeper-py
entries.title: Spotsweeper-py: spatially-aware quality control metrics for spatial omics data in the Python ecosystem
entries.one_liner: Python package computing neighborhood-aware z-scores for spatial QC metrics like counts and mito percentage.

entries.name: MAGPIE
entries.title: Spatially resolved integrative analysis of transcriptomic and metabolomic changes in tissue injury studies
entries.one_liner: Framework co-registering spatial transcriptomics, mass-spec metabolomics and morphology from matched tissue sections.

entries.name: spaTransfer
entries.title: spaTransfer: transfer learning for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data using non-negative matrix factorization
entries.one_liner: NMF-based transfer learning method to project cell type or spatial domain labels onto new datasets.

entries.name: SpotSweeper-py
entries.title: Spotsweeper-py: spatially-aware quality control metrics for spatial omics data in the Python ecosystem
entries.one_liner: Python package computing neighborhood-aware z-scores for spatial QC metrics like counts and mito percentage.

entries.name: spoon
entries.title: Addressing the mean-variance relationship in spatially resolved transcriptomics data with spoon
entries.one_liner: Empirical Bayes framework correcting mean-variance bias to improve spatially variable gene prioritization.

entries.name: LARIS
entries.title: LARIS enables accurate and efficient ligand and receptor interaction analysis in spatial transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Scalable method identifying cell-type-specific, spatially restricted ligand-receptor interactions with directionality across time.

entries.name: CadaST
entries.title: Probabilistic-graph-based spatial context-aware framework for interpretable spatial omics denoising and augmentation
entries.one_liner: Probabilistic graph-based framework denoising and imputing spatial omics data while preserving sharp boundaries.

entries.name: Castl
entries.title: Castl: Robust Identification of Spatially Variable Genes in Spatial Transcriptomics via an Ensemble-based Framework
entries.one_liner: Ensemble framework aggregating multiple SVG detection methods to control false discovery rates.

entries.name: Integrative Spatial Omics for Systems-Level Mapping of Pathological Niches
entries.title: Integrative Spatial Omics for Systems-Level Mapping of Pathological Niches
entries.one_liner: Multimodal pipeline combining MALDI-MSI lipidomics, spatial transcriptomics, protein imaging, and histology to map pathological niches.

entries.name: GHIST
entries.title: Spatial gene expression at single-cell resolution from histology using deep learning with GHIST
entries.one_liner: Deep learning framework predicts single-cell resolution spatial gene expression directly from histology images.

entries.name: DESpace2
entries.title: DESpace2 : detection of differential spatial patterns in spatial omics data
entries.one_liner: Detects differential spatial gene expression patterns between experimental conditions in spatial transcriptomics data.

entries.name: SpotSweeper
entries.title: SpotSweeper: spatially aware quality control for spatial transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Spatially aware quality control method detecting local outlier spots and regional tissue artifacts in SRT.

entries.name: spoon
entries.title: Addressing the mean-variance relationship in spatially resolved transcriptomics data with spoon
entries.one_liner: Empirical Bayes framework that removes mean-variance bias to better prioritize spatially variable genes.

entries.name: Xenium Prime 5K
entries.one_liner: Expanded in situ panel profiling ~5,000 genes at subcellular resolution.
